desc:
⚽ Physics soccer where ANYTHING can happen!
🆕 Latest update: Emotes/Celebrations
Matchmaking/Ranked will be added when the game grows!

🌀 Portals, banana peels, landmines and more crash every match, so no two games are the same
🤖 Play 1v1 up to 4v4, with bots filling empty spots so there's always a match
💥 Unlock goal explosions, auras, trails and custom jerseys
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards and save replays of your best goals
👥 Grab your friends and see who can handle the CHAOS!

🎮 Desktop, mobile, tablet and console
⭐ Favorite the game so you never miss an update
👍 Having fun? A like really helps us grow!

🛠️ CHAOS Football is in active development, with new events, maps and fixes all the time. Found a bug? Press FEEDBACK in game!
